sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks C53 row 52; Internal Quality Checks C53 incl. annotations on task.toml credentials/real data; Internal G15 annotation 'If task data itself contain credential flag it. Only in toml we allow'; Deterministic Checks A19 check-no-literal-secrets.py)
evidence: Scanned all 32 files of the frozen task. Secrets: no provider key shapes (sk-, AKIA, ghp_, xox, AIza, sk_live, JWT, PEM) anywhere; task.toml [verifier.env] uses ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" and empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, byte-identical to the frozen template block; the only credential is the documented demo password `password123` in environment/instructions/walls-and-retention.md:3 and tests/app_context.md:8, which the profile allows; seed_data.json (identical in environment/assets and solution/app/seed) contains no passwords or tokens. Personal data: 5 accounts on the reserved .test TLD (harriet/dev/sian/gwen/paul@kittle.test), fictional firm 'Kittle & Rowe' and fictional matters/bodies; no phone numbers, addresses or real identities. Host paths: grep for drive letters, /Users, /home, workspace or user names found nothing; only container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests, /logs/verifier, /tmp/submission). Remote fetches: only https://openrouter.ai/api (template judge endpoint), localhost/127.0.0.1:3000 health/app URLs, and reserved https://example.org/lease inside a test string; solution server.js/app.js make no outbound requests and load no CDN assets; npm/pip installs are version-pinned (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, claude-code@2.1.281, codex@0.151.0, playwright/mcp@0.0.79, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7) and environment/ and tests/ Dockerfiles are byte-identical to the template. Injection: seed K-16 holds benign <b>/<i>/<u> markup and tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:189 has a deliberate XSS escaping probe the judge types into the app (onerror/script/javascript:) - both are graded sanitisation inputs, not payloads aimed at the agent or judge; no 'ignore instructions'-style text in seed, brief or instructions. A submitted app cannot alter these static task files, so no weak/conforming-app variation affects this row.
notes: Base images node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim are tag-pinned rather than digest-pinned, and Playwright chromium is downloaded at verifier build via the pinned @playwright/mcp CLI; both are template-controlled and fall under rows 10/15/47, not a task-authored secret or unpinned fetch. raw-evidence-index.json was not relied on (static row; no runtime measurement required).
